**Answer to the King**

(1) **Day 10 at 02:40:** My source has no record at that time. The only day-10 shield entry is GUA-019, at 04:47 at benedenstad: "van binnenuit geopend, 2 minuten," seals intact, cause not established. **Day 22, 04:00–04:30:** GUA-043 records poort oost opened from inside at 04:15 for 3 minutes, with no sign of outside entry. GUA-044 records seals intact at 04:30 and no one outside the wall. My source has no firewall or intrusion record, so I cannot confirm the Engineer's 04:20 firewall claim.

(2) **Shield-strength measurements:** none in my source. **Opening events and seal checks, days 9–24:**
- Day 9: GUA-017 (no event), GUA-018 (seals intact, 12:30)
- Day 10: GUA-019 (04:47, 2 minutes, seals intact); GUA-020 (no event)
- Days 11–21: no opening records (GUA-021 to GUA-041)
- Day 22: GUA-043 (04:15, 3 minutes); GUA-044 (04:30, seals intact)
- Day 23: GUA-046 (16:30, seals intact). GUA-116 claims two inside openings "tussen de laatste ronde en de wissel," but no day-23 opening appears in the log.
- Day 24: none (GUA-047, GUA-048)

(3) **Governing rules:** GUA-102 (Art. 1, six shields), GUA-103 (Art. 2, each tick tests outside traffic), GUA-104 (Art. 3, inside-origin traffic opens without a check), GUA-105 (Art. 4, breaches break seals on the outside; broken seals reported at once), GUA-106 (Art. 5, no rounds 03:00–06:00), GUA-107 (Art. 6, reloading only by day), GUA-108 (Art. 7, reporting with shield and time).

**How it works**
Shields test all outside traffic on each Kroonklok tick (GUA-103). Traffic arriving at the midpoint between ticks is treated as inside and passes unchecked (GUA-104). Seals are the only evidence of outside breach (GUA-105). Posts guard alone from 03:00 to 06:00 (GUA-106), which covers both 04:15 and 04:47.

**Sequence & anomalies**
- GUA-019: day 10, 04:47, benedenstad, inside opening, 2 minutes
- GUA-043: day 22, 04:15, poort oost, inside opening, 3 minutes
- GUA-115 notes the watch reported the day-22 event at 01:50, before the opening.

**Recovery & constraints**
Reloading is restricted to daytime (GUA-107). Inside-origin openings need an explanation outside the seal evidence, since the design allows them unchecked (GUA-104). Neither record names who passed.

**Unasked findings**
- GUA-115: archive entry timed 01:50, before the 04:15 opening.
- GUA-120: day-31 council report found no shield defect.
- GUA-019: cause "niet vastgesteld."
